scope: 25 exact historical keys outside other assignments; exact old scopes and operators compared with source component review. Main meanings/stances of 0848/A4EB/2FE1/E37B directly rechecked to prevent broad projection.

rows.review_disposition: 21A/48B must retain Hoche’s troop movement inside the protected zone with Barras’s encouragement as a constitutional breach preparing coercion. It was one phase in cumulative army dependence, not neutral redeployment or its sole origin.
AC7C directly preserves defeated Nîmes Catholics feeding later Jalès mobilization. Keep the source-supported direction and 143/300 evidence rather than a generic common-south association.
4D74 preserves the Koblenz force’s dependence on coalition powers. Retain supply weakness and strategic marginality rather than equating nominal émigré strength with autonomous invasion capacity.
1D983 can internalize Provence’s regency and succession after the two royal deaths. Preserve dynastic claims, limited recognition and political viability as separate matters.

9DE8/F4D must preserve limited resistance contributing to confidence after Floréal without treating abstention as positive assent. A4EB’s broader expansion predates this moment and cannot be explained wholly by it.

0848 already spans lasting polarization and can retain 398’s connection back to oath/schism. Preserve mutual memories and long-term conflict without treating 1905 as a direct mechanical consequence of the Concordat alone.

4F5D must retain Condé’s dependence on Austria and limits of independent Bourbon capacity. C479 supplies foreign strategic interests; retirement is conditional on the named dependency, not merely two subject labels.

7742 can internalize declining strength as practical context for renewed compulsory recruitment. Distinguish law, activation and actual numbers, and avoid claiming manpower alone determines military effectiveness.
B888 can internalize decline of armed options encouraging Clichy’s electoral opportunity. It is a strategic redirection, not a claim that royalism began only after military defeat.

7742 can retain the same manpower-to-recruitment mechanism in the correct direction. Preserve actual military need, emergency claim on citizens and later resistance rather than a single numerical cause.
2FE1 can internalize Rome as a particular sister-republic creation, with local initiative/pretext, French military control and papal captivity. Preserve its differences from Dutch and Ligurian cases.

CB77 must retain property as the asserted foundation of competent, independent citizenship. Retire the unbound social-base label while preserving both normative argument and concrete franchise restrictions.
016962 correctly orients Artois organizing the émigré movement. Do not distribute that whole claim to every Quiberon or Condé record; retain actual princely leadership with its practical limits.

Religious détente reduced insurgent support as an accommodative mechanism. Bind B438/6EF and relevant western parents; British intervention C4FA is context, not the agent of French toleration or an equivalent destination.
CB77 can internalize five Directors, indirect choice through both Councils and annual retirement as checks on personal dominance. Preserve the actual institutional mechanism.

Retire a vague contrast between failed peace and invasion planning, but retain the sequence from Lille breakdown to renewed anti-British strategy in 2E013/DA4B. Campo Formio is a separate Austrian comparison, not equivalent to either endpoint.

A4EB should retain Rhine-frontier coercion and secularization compensation as diplomatic expansion. Do not automatically bind the exact territorial claim to sister-republic diversity or every war-finance facet; preserve the source’s chronology qualifications.

868926/6EF must retain Hoche’s defeat of Charette, capture and execution as part of pacification. Preserve Charette’s tactical peace, failed linkage and dwindling capacity, not willingness to fight as proof of strategic strength.
CB77 can internalize restricted electoral colleges as implementation of the property-competence argument. Keep primary voting rights distinct from the second-stage electorate.

8B315 can internalize Grenelle’s failed attempt to win troops, informer intervention and repression. An unbound military-subversion node is unnecessary and the failure is not evidence of widespread troop support.

Quiberon’s place in British strategy belongs in 612D/C4FA and the subsequent colonial shift in 51F. Do not retain the entire expedition as a requirement of the narrower Lille parent merely because old Pitt scope combined them.

304796/BBD must preserve royalist plotting in Lyons as distinct from the heterogeneous federalist movement. Retire a loose related edge without implying all city resistance was a successful royalist network.

5193 can internalize destruction of assignat plates as a symbolic end to issues. F6ED provides the subsequent mandates, not the ceremony’s direct target; preserve its failure to restore money or confidence immediately.

069F/C479 must retain conditional foreign support and strategic self-interest contributing to armed royalist failure alongside domestic divisions and republican military success. Avoid a single sufficient foreign-betrayal explanation.

FF3E must retain debt repudiation as an ideological breach of the Revolution’s commitment to public credit as well as fiscal relief. Retire the abstract abandoned-principles endpoint only with that judgment explicit.
